body:
﻿Reproduced in the integrated full-room-plan stack 54e45b4921, src/ui/room-template-world-bridge.ts.

A map pointerdown followed by pointercancel/lostpointercapture, or a release outside the canvas, leaves the stored pointer ID active. A subsequent pointerup on the map calls the placement port without a new press. Switching the selected plan between down/up also places the new plan rather than rejecting the stale gesture.

Four production-path unit reproductions fail against the current implementation, observing one unintended place call each. Expected: an interrupted or superseded press cannot place a plan; a fresh valid press still can. Fix in progress on the full integration branch; no save-format change.

comments.body: ﻿Fix pushed in b7a8c9ddac on draft integration PR #1899. Press ownership includes pointer ID and selected-plan revision; cancellation, lost capture, release outside the map, focus loss and Escape discard the unfinished press. Four reproductions were red before the fix; bridge/tool/composition suites now pass 36 tests, and TypeScript passes. Fresh presses still place the selected plan. Runtime browser follow-up is assigned; this issue is not closed before integration/release evidence.

title: Room plans: interrupted pointer gestures can place a stale or different plan
